value.markup:
The key insight behind MCP is that your data model (the "Model") should be completely independent from how you present and manage content (the "Content"). The "Platform" then provides the orchestration layer that connects them.

This separation allows you to:

  • Change your frontend without touching your data model
  • Reuse the same content structure across multiple projects
  • Have different teams work on model and content independently
  • Easily migrate between different CMS platforms

In Umbraco specifically, MCP enables you to build truly reusable block types and compositions that work across any site using the same patterns.
